title: First dictation after idle hears audio but transcribes no words
description:
Voicebar (~/Code/BubbleKeyboard, Android IME): the first dictation after the phone has been idle for a while often produces no words at all, while the next attempt works. Seen with ElevenLabs Scribe v2 Realtime (possibly also Parakeet). Happens both when auto-listen starts on tapping into a field and on a manual tap of Voice.

Observed (2026-10-22, build 1.5.5 with the new "Connecting…" state and speech/mic logging):
- "Connecting…" showed only a fraction of a second, so the ElevenLabs socket opened quickly. The user started talking after it cleared.
- The waveform moved, so the mic was producing audio levels.
- No words ever appeared (no live draft, no pill text); the dictation timed out.
- Pressing Voice again right after: it listens and transcribes normally.

So this is probably not (only) the slow-first-connection problem fixed earlier today (silence countdown now starts at the recognizer's ready signal; finishing before connection waits up to 8 s; keyboard-open warm-up; 3 s connect timeout).

Suspects, most likely first:
1. Voice filter: "Only my voice" / "Ignore children's voices" (VoiceFilterTranscriber). The waveform level is measured BEFORE the filter (MicRecorder → onLevel), but the recognizer gets the filtered audio. VoiceGate replaces blocks it judges "not the user" with zeros; its embedding model loads lazily on first use. A cold first run could be zeroing everything. Check for "filter: silenced a stretch" log lines and whether the filter is on.
2. ElevenLabs receives audio but returns empty partials (e.g. bad first chunk, previous_text lead-in, keyterms param), or an error / session message that is parsed as Other and ignored. No log of message types or bytes sent yet.
3. Words arrive but aren't shown: auto-listen guard holding live text until "engaged"; LiveTyper never confirmed; the pill not showing partials while voiceInField is true.
4. Mic contention with the wake-word listener ("Voice bar, listen anytime"), whose AudioRecord is released asynchronously: levels come from our recorder, but check that the recorder whose chunks are sent is the one producing audio.

Diagnostics already in place (Settings ▸ Logs, last 5 min): speech (connected in N ms, first words back, ended with no words back, warm-up), mic (first 2 s peak level), filter (silenced a stretch), dictation start line (auto/live/toClipboard).
To add: count of audio bytes actually sent per session; ElevenLabs message types received (session_started, partial empty vs non-empty, errors); whether the voice filter is active and its per-block verdicts on the first stretch; whether the guard engaged.
acceptance_criteria: Root cause identified from logs or a reproduction; the first dictation after a long idle transcribes like any other (live words appear within about a second of speaking); a regression test covers the cause; the logging added for diagnosis stays useful and quiet.
